title: Food-focused
slide_intent: Teach designers to show food in an abundant, natural context. Ingredients, utensils and preparation gestures help viewers understand how a product will be enjoyed.
strategic_value: Instacart can make an item feel like part of a meal by showing its textures, surroundings and handling.
demonstration: A dark green rule column accompanies a tiled montage of food preparation, plated dishes, close-ups and a pasta-serving gesture. Four descriptive words close the column.
practical_value: Choose between a plated scene, a pattern and a close-up, keeping enough contextual detail and contrast for the food to remain prominent.

content_islands.name: Brief and descriptors
content_islands.spec: Keep the food-focused heading and short guidance on the green left rail. Stack the four descriptive qualities near the foot.

content_islands.name: Food montage
content_islands.spec: Fill the rest of the page edge to edge. Alternate overhead ingredients, hands preparing food and closer plated views so the examples demonstrate a range within the tier.
